name: moongames
description: Portable MoonGames game packages sharing one Nakama backend.

scripts.build:web: pnpm build:chess && pnpm build:carrom && pnpm build:ludo && pnpm build:uno && pnpm catalog:generate && pnpm --filter @moongames/launcher build && node tools/assemble-web.mjs

scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:lua && pnpm test:tools
